title: Application Security Engineer
description: ABOUT PAYSTACK Paystack’s mission is to help merchants in Africa get paid by anyone, anywhere in the world. Tens of thousands of notable corporations and businesses in Africa use Paystack’s modern payments infrastructure, including MTN, Bolt, Domino’s Pizza, Smile Communications, AXA Mansard Insurance, and many others. Within over 9 years, our close-knit team has introduced a steady cadence of innovations within the African Payment space, such as automated recurring payments, the ability for customers to pay with only a bank account, automated chargebacks, and much more. We process well over $300 million in transactions monthly, and our double-digit growth has us processing even more every month. We’ve pioneered a new era of simple, powerful technology tools for businesses in Africa, and as we prepare for a period of accelerated growth, we’re looking to you to help build a solid foundation upon which we can support some of the continent’s best-performing businesses. At Paystack, we believe that we will win by recruiting talented people and giving them the space, resources, and support to do the best work of their lives. We hire the most capable people, treat them with genuine respect, and give them the means to succeed. And we’d love your help! As a leader of the Information Security function at Paystack, you will contribute to the business by presenting your technical expertise with a balanced approach to communication and a bias for action. You will be required to work with our leadership teams at all levels of the company to drive solutions that impact our platform for the good of Paystack and ultimately, our customers and stakeholders. You will leverage your experience across various tools and processes to establish policies and standards across the company. WHAT YOU’LL DO We're looking for an intermediate Application Security Engineer to join our Information Security Team. This is your chance to play a critical role in securing Paystack's rapidly growing fintech platform and ensuring that our customers' trust remains unwavering. You'll work closely with our Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to safeguard our applications from design to deployment. From penetration testing and vulnerability management to building a culture of secure development, you'll be the expert who ensures security is embedded into everything we build. If you're passionate about protecting systems, love a technical challenge, and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment — this role was made for you. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES As an Application Security Engineer/Analyst, you will be a key contributor to our security posture, working closely with engineering and product teams. Your responsibilities will include: - Application Security Testing: Conduct web and mobile application security assessments and API security testing. Perform threat modelling, secure code reviews, and attack surface analysis. Support SAST and DAST initiatives. - Vulnerability Management: Assist in managing the vulnerability lifecycle. Coordinate internal and external security assessments, ensuring proper scoping and timely delivery. Track and report on remediation progress. - Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Integration: Ensure secure coding practices are followed. Collaborate with developers, testers, and business analysts to provide proactive security guidance during development sprints. Contribute to security frameworks, checklists, and guidelines (aligned with OWASP, NIST, MITRE). Work on DevSecOps testing and protective controls. - Incident Response Support: Assist in the investigation and resolution of application security incidents. Contribute to post-incident analysis and implement preventative measures. - Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Stay informed about cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and attack vectors. Research and contribute to the implementation of innovative security solutions. Identify process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of security assessments. WHO YOU ARE A few things we expect you should have to be able to meet the demands of the role include: - Minimum 3 years in application security, IT security, or software development with a security focus - Hands-on experience with penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and secure code reviews - Proven experience with SAST, DAST, and threat modelling frameworks - Practical knowledge of secure software development practices (OWASP Top 10, CWE) - Hands-on development experience or scripting ability (Python, JavaScript, Bash) - Strong understanding of web application security, API security, and cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - Understanding of DevSecOps principles and CI/CD security integration - Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences - Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally BENEFITS - Competitive compensation package and benefits - Stripe Equity compensation - Full medical coverage - Wellbeing stipend - Generous leave and sabbatical policies - Hybrid working environment - Smart, kind colleagues who’re invested in your growth. Paystack is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to providing employees with a work environment that is progressive and open-minded. Our employment philosophy is to hire the best people and empower them to do the best work of their lives. Employment decisions are based on business needs and individual merit without regard to race, colour, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, gender or age.

title: Debt Collection Process Lead
description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Mogo is Kenya's fast-scaling fintech - part of Eleving Group, a global financial services platform operating across 16+ countries. We are redefining access to vehicle financing, microfinance, and smartphone financing for everyday Kenyans. Our mission is simple: make progress accessible. We are dedicated to fostering upward social mobility in diverse communities by providing credit access to entrepreneurs who are often excluded from traditional banking. Through a combination of asset financing, fintech innovations, AI-based underwriting, and proprietary car portals, we empower local entrepreneurs, such as motorcycle taxi riders, Uber/Bolt drivers, and small business owners, to purchase their own vehicles and obtain loans to expand their businesses. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a data-driven and hands-on Debt Collection Process Lead to design, optimize, and manage end-to-end collections workflows for vehicle and device finance in Kenya. In this role, you will lead initiatives that strengthen the customer repayment experience while ensuring collections operations remain efficient, compliant, and scalable. On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with the Head of Debt Collection and partner teams across Credit/Risk, Customer Service, Product/IT, and Legal to turn data insights into operational improvements. This is a high-impact role for someone who is proactive, structured, and takes full ownership. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Process design & optimization - Design and continuously improve consumer collections processes across all delinquency stages - Introduce and scale automation (case allocation rules, workflows, customer communications) and explore robotics/AI use cases to improve efficiency and cost-to-collect. - Audit current workflows, improve them end-to-end (test and implement changes), and design new processes where needed. 2. Documentation & training - Create and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and training materials to ensure consistent execution across internal teams and external partners (if applicable). - Support onboarding and continuous training for collections agents and related stakeholders. 3. Cross-functional delivery - Partner with Customer Service, Credit/Risk, Product/IT, Legal, and any BPO/agency partners to implement data-driven collections improvements. - Coordinate testing and rollouts of new strategies, communications, tooling changes, and policy updates. 4. Continuous improvement - Use customer feedback, agent input, and performance analytics to identify bottlenecks (e.g., contractability, broken PTP, queue management, dispute handling). - Propose improvements, drive execution, and track impact through clear initiatives and timelines. 5. S/he ensures that SMZ's IT systems and processes are not just functional and secure, but that staff and field users are well-supported and empowered to leverage technology to deliver their best work at scale. This role is responsible for adapting and implementing the global Information Technology framework to meet SMZ's unique local requirements with precision and integrity, serving as the first Zambia-based representative on a small, close-knit global IT team.

S/he works seamlessly with the global IT team and SMZ leadership across Programs, Research, Finance, HR, and M&E to foster technology use that aligns with organizational goals. S/he serves as the first line of technical support and is an independent, switched-on operator who runs SMZ's office infrastructure and field user networks with minimal hand-holding, building and improving systems where s/he sees opportunity. S/he is an exemplary user support lead for every type of user, from frontline field staff to executive leadership, ensuring that national hardware and software needs are met with urgency while representing SMZ's specific field requirements to the global stage. S/he will manage additional junior tech support resources as the team continues to grow.

Beyond day-to-day operations, this role also contributes to SMZ's broader digital transformation, supporting the development and implementation of a new global data management system, helping to test and refine field data collection tools, designing dashboards and supporting strategic data use, and experimenting with AI integrations. The Lead will also take a significant role in strategizing and executing integrations with government HMIS and eCHIS systems.

While we have defined high technical standards, we recognize that exceptional talent often follows non-traditional paths. We strongly encourage applications from high-potential candidates who may not meet every formal qualification but possess a proven track record of self-directed upskilling and a relentless passion for learning. If you are a rapid learner with a 'can-do' attitude toward solving complex problems, we want to hear from you.

This role reports to the Digital Transformation Director.

What You Will Do

  1. Independent Office Infrastructure & Asset Management:

    • Activities: Own the full IT asset lifecycle end-to-end, from procurement to disposal, with minimal hand-holding. Ensure licensing compliance; manage G Suite/user permissions; enforce security protocols and audit logs.

    • Expected Outputs: Comprehensive IT Asset Register; 100% licensing compliance; Secure user access management and standardized hardware provisioning process.

  2. Network Infrastructure & Maintenance:

    • Activities: Lead maintenance and upgrades of firewalls, network infrastructure, and connectivity strategy spanning main office and field sites; monitor performance for high availability; manage provisioning for laptops/tablets.

    • Expected Outputs: 99.9% uptime; Stable and secure network; efficient access for field workers.

  3. Data Security, Business Continuity, and Compliance:

    • Activities: Implement and rigorously test automated backup/recovery procedures for program data and SaaS stack; maintain incident logs; develop disaster recovery protocols for SMZ systems. Will act as chief ODPC data protection officer.

    • Expected Outputs: Data integrity and zero-loss recovery; Up-to-date Backup Log; Adherence to global policies; Incident Response Registry. Continuous certification and compliance with ODPC regulations.

  4. Phenomenal User Support & IT Operations:

    • Activities: Serve as the first line of technical support for every kind of user, from frontline field staff to executive leadership. Lead high-level troubleshooting; oversee the SMZ incident log; provide monthly reporting on system health and support trends.

    • Expected Outputs: Rapid ticket resolution; Monthly IT Performance Reports; Optimized system reliability, stellar feedback from team.

  5. Digital Transformation & Systems:

    • Activities: Map local workflows to inform global system overhaul; lead local implementation of data management migrations; ensure Zambian field realities are integrated into design.

    • Expected Outputs: Seamless migration to new data systems; Documented local requirements; Zero data loss during transitions; high user adoption and success rates.

    • Activities: Oversee maintenance and update cycles for field tools (Kobo, CommCare); support testing of AI prototypes and digital data capture innovations; strengthen field user networks nationwide.

    • Expected Outputs: High-functioning field tools; viable prototypes; documented QA evaluations; scalable digital innovations.

  7. Data Analytics & Reporting:

    • Activities: Support advanced data extraction and analytics for M&E and Programs; automate dashboards to facilitate data-driven leadership decisions.

    • Expected Outputs: Accurate data exports; Real-time automated dashboards for SMZ leadership.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in the IT sector, with a proven track record in software engineering, network infrastructure, or the strategic oversight of complex data systems.

  • Inclusive User Support: Extensive experience providing technical assistance across a wide variety of users, from frontline staff to executive leadership.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

  • BSc/BA in Computer Science/Information Technology/Software Engineering or relevant field.

  • Professional Certifications desirable, e.g., PMP/PRINCE2, ITIL, Google Workspace Administration, or similar

  • Data architecture: Proficiency in SQL for relational database management, seamless data migration, and complex querying to support global system overhauls and BI needs.

  • Technical Innovation: Working knowledge of Python to drive data automation, manage API integrations, and support the development and testing of AI prototypes.

  • Familiarity with government digital health systems.

  • Experience with configuration and management of field data collection platforms, specifically KoboToolbox and CommCare

  • Methodology & Design: Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies, with experience documenting technical requirements and physical designs.

  1. We are people focused. Our clients are the top priority, and we ensure they receive the best possible care and support. Our employees matter and we enable our team to thrive. We respect all our stakeholders and treat them as equals.

    • Behaviors Indicators:

      • Puts clients’ first (internal and external)

      • Respect for all stakeholders

      • Show care and provide support to all our clients – both internal and external

      • Treat all stakeholders equally.

      • Foster a spirit of teamwork

  2. We think big and act fast. We are passionate about achieving our bold mission. We move with urgency and focus on achieving scale. We continually find new ways to work and to solve problems.

    • Behaviors Indicators:

      • Works with urgency

      • Focus on achieving the Mission.

      • New and innovative ways of working to solve problems

  3. We are data-driven. Data is at our core. It guides us and drives our decision-making.

    • Behaviors Indicators:

      • Decision-making driven by data.

      • Putting data at the core of StrongMinds operations

  4. We do what we say and say what we do. We are open and direct in our communications. We are honest in our interactions. No funny business.

    • Behaviors Indicators:

      • Open and direct communication

      • Honesty in all interactions

      • High level of integrity

  5. We believe in collaboration, not competition. We do not compete with other mental health implementers. We welcome their contributions to achieving our mission and partner with them whenever possible.

    • Behaviors Indicators:

      • Partnership with other mental health implementers

      • Collaboration within teams

Your job, in collaboration with others in the product and engineering teams, will be to write elegant, performant, and well-tested code that improves our products in meaningful ways. 

You will be expected to contribute to features, bug fixes, tests, and infrastructure code alike, through both software and systems engineering. This role reports to Boost’s Chief Technology Officer (CTO). 



 1. Write elegant, performant, and well-tested code 
    
    You will work side-by-side with the product and engineering teams to ship new—and improve existing—code: 
    
    - Work to understand the wider purpose of each feature you work on. 
    
    - Define, communicate, and execute on a clear plan for your work, while ensuring any unclear expectations are clarified. 
    
    - Scope larger features down into smaller, actionable items of work. 
    
    - Strive to reduce technical debt and communicate larger refactors. 
    
    - Support the work of your peers through pairing, reviewing, and mentoring. 
    
    - Prepare clean and well-written pull requests, and help to ship your work. 
    
    - Actively participate in broader engineering efforts.
    
    - Raise the bar for customer experience! 

 2. Enable the engineering team to make better decisions 
    
    We work in a collaborative way—and as a member of the Platform team, you will be in one of the best positions to promote collaboration, learning, and prioritisation across teams. 
    
    - Contribute to the Platform roadmap and prioritisation. 
    
    - Work closely with in-country product teams to better understand product requests and ensure requirements are well written and understood.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years’ experience in a relevant field

 - A deep knowledge of Python and the ability to write clear and Pythonic code. 

 - Strong AI expertise and an AI-first mindset, with the judgment to know when to guide closely and when to delegate. 

 - Experience working with relational databases and SQL (any dialect is fine, but we work with PostgreSQL). 

 - Experience working with cloud infrastructure (we use AWS). 

 - Relevant experience in a similar role, preferably within a fast-growing startup. 

 - Openness to others’ ideas with a shared desire to understand and communicate the purpose of the work. 




WHO YOU ARE

 - Keen, bright, and your superpower is curiosity. 

 -  Comfortable in a fast-paced environment and with a passion for learning from and delighting customers

 - Someone with an engineering, mathematical, or scientific background.  

 - Someone who supports the work of their peers through pair programming, reviewing, and mentoring. 

 - Someone who adjusts well to shifting priorities when necessary. 

 - Someone who loves to share what they’re learning and working remotely. 

 - Someone who is a great communicator and loves to build bridges between people with different backgrounds and cultures—and in different locations. 

 - Motivated by our mission, resonates with our virtues and principles, and ambitious to grow into a larger future role. 




BOOST VIRTUES 

These virtues should strongly resonate with you and are the foundations of the company we will build together:  

 - Be purpose-driven: You should be motivated by the potential to enable informal retailers to thrive in the digital economy. 

 - Be tenacious: When faced with adversity, you relentlessly persevere until you find a solution. 

 - Be compassionate: You are able to empathise with others to feel their pain and then take actionable steps to deliver solutions that alleviate it. 

 - Be whole: You live to work and achieve results, but you take care of your well-being. 

 - Be good: You are always your honest, authentic self who does the right thing, even when under pressure.

raw_data.descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Mogo's mission is to enable upward social mobility for people in diverse communities around the world by providing entrepreneurs who are excluded from traditional banking systems with access to credit. By combining asset financing, fintech, AI-based underwriting, and proprietary car portals, we enable these local entrepreneurs (motorcycle taxi riders, Uber/Bolt drivers, and small business owners) to find and purchase their own vehicles.

About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Financial Analyst to support the financial performance, operational efficiency, and growth of Mogo Kenya. This role provides exposure across multiple areas of finance, including treasury, financial control, business control, and fundraising, offering an excellent opportunity to build a broad foundation in financial operations.

 

This is a hands-on analytical position for a numerate, detail-oriented early-career professional who enjoys working with data and is eager to develop expertise across the full finance function.

What You Will Do

  1. Treasury & Payments

    • Support day-to-day cash management and the execution of payments for Mogo Kenya.

    • Help reconcile bank and payment-platform balances, and flag discrepancies for review.

    • Assist in automating cash and payment flows (e.g., building or maintaining Excel/Python tooling) and in strengthening financial controls around them.

    • Prepare cash position summaries and short-term liquidity reports.

  2. Business Control

    • Build and maintain dashboards and analyses (Excel, SQL, Python) that surface cost and process-optimization opportunities across call centre, field, commercial, finance, procurement, accounts payable, and broader operations.

    • Support recurring operational reviews with clear, well-structured analysis.

  3. Financial Control

    • Support the production of P&L, balance sheet, and portfolio analytics, including product and service splits.

    • Prepare inter-company recharge schedules between Mogo Kenya and related Mogo/Eleving entities for review.

    • Assist in the forecasting and budgeting cycle — gathering inputs, populating models, and tracking actuals against budget.

  4. Fundraising & Investor Relations

    • Support the sourcing and closing of investment deals by preparing data, analyses, and presentation materials.

    • Help maintain data rooms and supporting documentation.

    • Assist with covenant tracking, investor reporting, and compliance follow-ups.

What You Have

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or another quantitative field.

  • Some practical experience (through an internship or up to 2 years of work experience) in finance, treasury, audit, FP&A, data analytics, or a related field.

  • Excel: advanced proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, clean model and report structuring).

  • SQL: able to write queries to extract, filter, join, and aggregate data from databases.

  • Python: comfortable using Python (e.g., pandas) for data cleaning, analysis, and basic automation.

  • Exposure to financial services, fintech, lending, or multi-country operations.

  • Experience working with BI and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

  • A solid understanding of accounting fundamentals, including P&L, balance sheets, and reconciliations.

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet reporting deadlines.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis simply and understandably.

  • A proactive and curious mindset, with a strong willingness to learn across the full finance function.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months):

  • You build a strong understanding of Mogo Kenya's financial operations and become a reliable contributor across treasury, financial control, and business control functions.

  • You turn raw data into actionable insights and deliver accurate, timely reporting that supports key business decisions.

  • You automate and improve existing processes, helping the finance team work more efficiently.

  • You become a trusted partner for data and analysis and start taking ownership of cross-functional projects that contribute to the company's growth.

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to build a broad foundation across multiple finance disciplines rather than being limited to a single function.

  • Continuous personal and professional development opportunities to accelerate your professional growth through meaningful responsibility from day one.

  • Monthly housing allowance.

  • Relocation support, including flights, visas, and vaccinations.

  • Monthly housing allowance.

  • 2 flights home per year.

  • Bonuses based on company and individual performance.
